title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: One new skill a week
hook: How many new skills did you teach this week?
intro: Kids never get good at any of it.
statement: Depth beats variety for young players.
q1: Do you teach one new skill a week and repeat it —
q2: or introduce something new each practice?
q3: Which skill from last month do they still use?
t1: Both can work. But skills last
t2: when kids have time to make them their own.
cta: Coaches — how fast do you add skills?
ctaLines: One a week. One a practice. When they are ready.
Slow and deep or quick and wide?
ctaPrompt: Share your teaching habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How many new skills did you teach this week?
Every practice brings something new. Kids never get good at any of it.
Depth beats variety for young players.
One new skill a week or something new each practice. Every team is different.
How fast do you add skills? Share your habit in the comments.
